verdict.rationale: An AI API platform could plausibly offer versioning, review, and rollback for saved automations such as prompts, workflows, or agent harness configs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such capability. The model-lifecycle changelog covers vendor model deprecations, not versioning or rolling back a user's own automations, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
